text:
I can only see the meal before eating, so the leftover figure is a guess. I estimated each item from the photo.

- **Grilled cheese sandwich:** two slices of whole-grain toast with a little cheese, about 280 kcal, 12 g protein, 28 g carbohydrate and 13 g fat.
- **Fruit salad:** watermelon, melon and apple, about 80 kcal, 1 g protein, 19 g carbohydrate and 0.5 g fat.
- **Juice:** about 150 ml of apple juice, about 70 kcal, 0 g protein, 17 g carbohydrate and 0 g fat.

Together the meal is about 430 kcal. I assumed about 15% would be left over, roughly 65 kcal, which leaves about 365 kcal eaten. Scaling the macronutrients by the same proportion gives the figures below.

{"served_kcal": 430, "leftover_kcal": 65, "kcal": 365, "protein_g": 11, "carbs_g": 55, "fat_g": 11}
